name: TAVARDT Cloudflare WAF Hardening Ruleset
description: Production edge firewall ruleset for perimeter defense, CMS protection, sensitive file blocking, and rate limiting.

rules.description: TAVARDT-WAF-01: Block access to environment variables, git repositories, and database dumps
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/.env" or http.request.uri.path contains "/.git" or http.request.uri.path contains "/config.json" or http.request.uri.path contains "/composer.json" or http.request.uri.path contains "/package.json" or http.request.uri.path contains ".sql" or http.request.uri.path contains ".dump")

rules.description: TAVARDT-WAF-02: Block automated security scanners and exploit probes
rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "nikto" or http.user_agent contains "sqlmap" or http.user_agent contains "acunetix" or http.user_agent contains "masscan" or http.user_agent contains "zgrab" or http.user_agent contains "nmap" or http.user_agent contains "dirbuster" or http.user_agent contains "gobuster")

rules.description: TAVARDT-WAF-03: Block WordPress XML-RPC abuse and trackbacks
TAVARDT-WAF-04: Block dangerous or non-standard HTTP methods
TAVARDT-WAF-05: Managed challenge for sensitive administrative endpoints
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-login.php" or http.request.uri.path contains "/administrator" or http.request.uri.path contains "/admin/login") and not ip.geoip.asnum in {13335}
